### Post 1: Full-Time Score
Saltcombe Rovers took home a hard-fought 2-1 win over Duskvale Wanderers! The game was all but decided in the first half with Emre Lomax opening the scoring [F61], and Leon Quinlan cementing the victory [F74]. Theo Ibarra scored a late goal for Duskvale [F80] but it was too little, too late. Who do you think played the decisive role? #FTScore

---

### Post 2: Stat-of-the-Match
Saltcombe Rovers dominated possession with 61% [F15] and created twice as many big chances as Duskvale Wanderers [F19]. Their goal from Emre Lomax [F61] turned the match's momentum. #StatoftheMatch

---

### Post 3: Turning-Point Post
The match's turning point came at the 6th minute when Emre Lomax scored, swinging Saltcombe Rovers' win probability from 47% to 65% [F59]. This early goal not only changed the game but also sent a strong message to Duskvale Wanderers. #TurningPoint
